help.reply:
🤖 *Mikami List Command*

📅 *Google Calendar* [ `@calendar` ] :
• `@calendar-auth` — Connect Calendar
• `@calendar-today` — Lihat jadwal hari ini
• `@calendar-week` — Lihat jadwal minggu ini
• `@calendar-create <judul> | 2024-08-15T14:00 | 2024-08-15T15:00` — Buat event baru

📈 *Google Analytics* [ `@analytics` ] :
• `@analytics [alias/ID]` — Report traffic web (7 hari terakhir)
• `@analytics-realtime [alias/ID]` — Report real-time active users
• `@analytics-pages [alias/ID]` — Top 10 page
• `@analytics-source [alias/ID]` — Sumber traffic utama

📓 *Obsidian* [ `@obsidian` ] :
• `@obsidian-search <kata kunci>` — Cari note
• `@obsidian-read <judul>` — Baca isi note

🖼️ *Stiker* [ `@sticker` ] :
• `@sticker` — Kirim gambar untuk bikin stiker

🧠 *Memori* [ `@memory` ] :
• `@memory <pesan>` — Simpan memori mu
• `@memory-clear` — Hapus semua memori mu

❓ *Bantuan* [ `@help` ] :
• `@help` — Tampilkan semua command
